name: kdcube
description: Official KDCube plugins for coding agents — install and operate KDCube, and build apps (bundles) that run on it.

plugins.name: kdcube
plugins.description: Claude Code app builder for backend-plus-frontend AI apps as KDCube bundles: guided CLI runtime init, local and public app websites, bundle registration/configuration, widgets/main UI, APIs, tools, jobs, integrations, testing, release, and an offline Tier 1 docs pack. Reads KDCube knowledge from the local KDCube checkout, with the hosted docs MCP at https://kdcube.tech/mcp/docs as a live fallback.

plugins.name: rms
plugins.description: Requirements Management System for coding agents: capture requirements as a side-effect of coding work, keep an inbox-first review loop, mark implementations with traceable code markers, and validate conformance before declaring work done. Ships the rms stdio MCP server and fetches its own platform binary on setup — no Rust or Node toolchain required.
